posts.title: 2025 Year-End Reflections
posts.description: As the year closes, I find myself less interested in achievements and more interested in alignment . Not alignment in the performative sense—OKRs lining up neatly, narratives tying themselves into bows—but alignment between how I think , how I act , and how I live . posts.title: Technology Has Reshaped the Way We Connect
posts.description: We’ve become so accustomed to niches and narrowcasting that our social lives now follow the same logic. We connect through narrow interfaces — shared interests, curated identities, matching tags — and hesitate to reach beyond them, afraid of being denied access or dismissed as irrelevant.
